stories.title: ¡Toma en cuenta! Estas son las marchas y concentraciones previstas para este domingo 20 de septiembre

en.title: Take note! These are the marches and gatherings planned for this Sunday, September 20
en.summary: Multiple marches and gatherings are scheduled for September 20 in Mexico City, including an open event organized by Refugio Franciscano A.C. in the Cuajimalpa borough.

stories.title: ¿Cómo estará el clima este domingo en CDMX?; prevén una temperatura máxima de 26 °C

en.title: How will the weather be this Sunday in Mexico City?; maximum temperature of 26 °C is expected
en.summary: Mexico City is forecast to reach a maximum of 26 degrees Celsius on Sunday, with wind gusts up to 45 kilometers per hour.

stories.title: Ucrania lanza ofensiva con más de mil drones contra Rusia; es el “mayor ataque de la historia” contra la capital rusa

en.title: Ukraine launches offensive with over one thousand drones against Russia; it is the "largest attack in history" against the Russian capital
en.summary: Ukraine conducted a major drone attack on Russia during the final day of Russia's first wartime parliamentary elections, with officials describing it as historically significant.

stories.title: Ucrania lanza el mayor ataque con drones contra Moscú, durante las elecciones en Rusia

en.title: Ukraine launches largest drone attack against Moscow, during elections in Russia
en.summary: Ukraine executed a major drone attack on Moscow coinciding with Russian parliamentary elections, while the Kremlin emphasizes national unity and information control during its military operation in Ukraine.

stories.title: Lanza Ucrania el mayor ataque de drones contra Rusia

en.title: Ukraine Launches Largest Drone Attack Against Russia
en.summary: Ukrainian forces conducted a major drone strike with over one thousand unmanned aircraft against Russia, resulting in casualties and damage to an oil refinery during parliamentary elections.

stories.title: Clima en México este domingo 20 de septiembre: lluvias intensas golpearán al sur y sureste

en.title: Weather in Mexico This Sunday, September 20: Intense Rains Will Hit the South and Southeast
en.summary: Southern and southeastern Mexican states face heavy rainfall from a low-pressure system with cyclonic potential, while temperatures in some regions are expected to reach 45 degrees Celsius.

stories.title: Atacan casa de diseñador que bordó vestido de CSP

en.title: Home of Designer Who Embroidered President's Dress Attacked
en.summary: The residence of Elvis Guerra, a designer who created embroidered elements of President Sheinbaum's dress worn during Independence Day ceremonies, was shot at in an attack.

stories.title: Trump anuncia que creará una fuerza de IA en vez de frenarla

en.title: Trump announces he will create an AI force instead of restraining it
en.summary: US President Donald Trump warned critics of artificial intelligence and data centers that he will not permit the destruction of the industry.

stories.title: EU y Dinamarca firmarán durante Asamblea de la ONU pacto sobre Groenlandia

en.title: US and Denmark will sign agreement on Greenland during UN Assembly
en.summary: Denmark's Prime Minister Mette Frederiksen will travel to New York to sign a security pact with the United States regarding Greenland during the UN General Assembly annual session.

stories.title: Atacan casa de diseñador textil zapoteco; denuncia amenazas y extorsión

en.title: Zapotec Textile Designer's Home Attacked; Reports Threats and Extortion
en.summary: Elvis Guerra, a Zapotec textile designer whose handcrafted outfit was worn by President Sheinbaum during Independence Day ceremonies, reported his home was fired upon and he faces threats and extortion demands.

stories.title: Trump anuncia una “Fuerza de IA” y advierte que no permitirá frenar el desarrollo de la tecnología

en.title: Trump announces an "AI Force" and warns he will not allow technology development to be slowed
en.summary: Trump announced plans for an AI Force through his Truth Social platform without providing details about leadership, responsibilities, or operational structure of the new governmental entity.

stories.title: Dinamarca celebra acuerdo con EU sobre Groenlandia, pero descarta ceder soberanía

en.title: Denmark celebrates agreement with EU on Greenland, but rules out ceding sovereignty
en.summary: Washington will expand its military presence in the strategic Arctic island while Copenhagen and Nuuk assert that the agreement does not alter their sovereignty.

stories.title: Trump no tolerará los intentos de frenar el desarrollo de la IA

en.title: Trump will not tolerate attempts to slow AI development
en.summary: The president rejects growing societal skepticism toward artificial intelligence, which has been fueled by warnings about potential dangers to humanity.

stories.title: Planes Premium de Disney+ “puede incluir anuncios”, pero no es tan malo como parece

en.title: Disney+ Premium plans "may include ads," but it's not as bad as it seems
en.summary: The streaming platform faces user complaints about increasingly restrictive measures being implemented on its service.

stories.title: 10 millones de dispositivos y menos de cinco segundos, la carrera de SkyAlert ante un sismo

en.title: 10 million devices and less than five seconds, SkyAlert's race against an earthquake
en.summary: SkyAlert's earthquake alert system uses sensors, artificial intelligence, and cloud computing to detect earthquakes and distribute alerts to millions of devices in seconds. The technology analyzes potential impact before sending notifications.

stories.title: Registro telefónico llega a 54.7%, mientras las fallas en plataformas aún complican la vinculación

en.title: Telephone Registration Reaches 54.7%, While Platform Failures Continue to Complicate Linking
en.summary: More than half of active telephone lines are now registered, but technical issues with platforms persist in hindering users from completing the linking process.
